about: What the video says, line by line. `pnpm video:voice` turns each line into one audio clip (ElevenLabs) and writes src/data/narration.json with its length and word timings, so subtitles land on the word. The call is a simulation with a demo resident, condensed, and shown in English: the real agent speaks Spanish, and the screen says so. Figures: 1,300 evacuated and 5 homes (Tribuna de Ávila, Ávilared, 23 July 2026); about 38,000 ha (37,818 provisional, Junta de Castilla y León via Ávilared, 21 Aug) and 229 homes inside the burned area (Idealista's estimate via Ávilared, 31 Jul), see docs/findings/2026-09-19-press-figures.md; 2 seconds is the dashboard's triage refresh; lead time as the team publishes it (DESIGN.md, frontend/src/domain/leadTime.ts): about 6 hours, 5 to 8 depending on the distance (2–5 km), 15:30 to 21:38 at 3 km.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On the twenty-third of July, the Burgohondo fire reached La Atalaya, in El Tiemblo.
lines.say: On the twenty-third of July, the Burgo-ondo fire reached La Atalaya, in El Tiemblo.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That day, the fire burned about thirty-eight thousand hectares in Ávila, and two hundred and twenty-nine homes stood inside the burned area.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The warning was an ES-Alert: one message, sent to every phone.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It couldn't say who had left, who couldn't move, or who never got it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: We can't rerun that day. What HackFire changes is what the coordinator knows: every household answers, and each answer reaches the map within two seconds.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: HackFire calls every resident, and listens.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It reads Deepfire's satellite hotspots, and forecasts where the fire is heading.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At half past three, the forecast put La Atalaya in its path.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The first hotspot within three kilometres came at nine thirty-eight that night.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: About six hours of lead time, from satellite data alone.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A coordinator approves the order. Then a voice agent calls every registered resident.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I'm calling from the emergency coordination about the fire. You must leave now for San Martín de Valdeiglesias, on the N-403.
lines.say: I'm calling from the emergency coordination about the fire. You must leave now for San Martín de Valdeiglesias, on the N-four-oh-three.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Can you leave on your own?

lines.speaker: resident
lines.text: I can, but my mother can't walk. There are two of us.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I've reported that you need help. Stay together, with your phone at hand.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She can't leave on her own. The agent understood it from what she said, not from a keyword.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every rescue is queued by how soon the fire reaches it, and shared out between the crews, each with its route.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every route goes around the fire: the roads it has reached are closed, and the coordinator can close any other with a tap.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The coordinator can ask the agent by voice, and with Vonage, share the live map with every crew.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Next: real phone lines, and a handover to a person at the control post.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: After that, more regions, built into the firefighters' workflow.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And the forecast will learn from every fire. Devin will replay each one against the real satellite hotspots, measure the error, and propose a better model.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nothing ships unless it beats today's model on fires it has never seen, and every call's answers become new tests for the agent.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: HackFire doesn't replace ES-Alert. It listens back.
lines.say: HackFire doesn't replace E.S.-Alert. It listens back.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every resident who leaves on their own is a rescue the firefighters don't have to make.
